title: Player (Ingame) Doxxer
description: A server-sided Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds a command that tells you the coordinates/location of a player that is online.
body:
A Forge 1.20.1 mod that is installed onto a server, adding new commands: 
- /dox
- /livefeed
- (more expected in the future)

# Warning - !
I named this mod "Player Doxxer" as a funny little joke you know like haha doxxed in minecraft lol i'll come kill you because i know where you are now haha ez ok you get it thanks
